environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'order-ns' with Istio sidecar injection enabled. An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the mesh level that uses a CUSTOM action provider ('ext-authz-jwt-strict') configured in the mesh config extensionProviders. This provider performs algorithm-pinned JWT validation at the Envoy proxy layer before traffic reaches the application container. Additionally, a namespace-scoped PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS, and a RequestAuthentication resource specifies the issuer with forwardOriginalToken: false, meaning the sidecar strips and re-validates tokens. The RequestAuthentication resource explicitly sets 'fromHeaders' with name 'Authorization' and jwksUri pointing to the internal JWKS with outputClaimToHeaders mapping. The AuthorizationPolicy has rules with 'from' sources restricted to principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/gateway-ns/sa/ingress-gateway' only, denying all other source namespaces. A second AuthorizationPolicy with DENY action blocks any request where request.auth.claims[iss] does not match the expected issuer OR where the original token header 'alg' (extracted via Lua filter in EnvoyFilter) is not 'RS256'.

envoy_filter.logic: extract JWT header alg field, reject if not RS256
